//: Typecheck-only config that also covers tests. The build config keeps rootDir at src (its declaration output depends on it), so test fixtures drifting out of sync with a contract change would otherwise go unnoticed until the suite runs. Only the DOM-free modules are testable this way, which is why every drag decision this plugin makes lives in `src/contract.ts` rather than in the client entry. `allowJs` lets tests import the CI scripts' pure helpers (`scripts/*.mjs`) with their JSDoc types, without checking the scripts themselves.
